title: Start a Firecrawl job
description: Starts a scrape (synchronous), a crawl or a batch scrape (both asynchronous, refresh with /sync) on a firecrawl connection and stores the job reference.

type.title: Job type
type.description: scrape: one page, synchronous; crawl: the site from the URL, asynchronous; batch_scrape: the pages listed in urls, asynchronous.

url.title: URL
url.description: Absolute http(s) URL to scrape or to start the crawl from. Required for scrape and crawl, ignored for batch_scrape.

urls.title: URLs
urls.description: Absolute http(s) URLs to scrape in one batch. Required for batch_scrape, ignored otherwise; the first URL becomes the job's url, the full list is stored as options.urls.

options.title: Firecrawl options
options.description: Firecrawl v2 request options passed through with the URL, e.g. formats, limit, scrapeOptions. A url (or, for batch_scrape, urls) given here is ignored.

apiConfiguration.title: Firecrawl connection
apiConfiguration.description: IRI of an active firecrawl connection; its UUID or its name (without spaces) is accepted as well. Omit to use the single active connection.
